howto.what: Claude会帮你添加、修复或审查网页的结构化数据(JSON-LD)。它会检查必需属性和值格式,确保只标记页面可见内容,并给出可直接粘贴的完整代码块,同时说明该代码可申请的富结果类型。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加、修复或审查结构化数据(如文章、产品、FAQ 等),或询问标记为何未获得富结果时触发。

howto.what_en: Helps add, fix, or review JSON-LD. Checks required properties and value shapes, flags invisible content, and provides paste-ready code with the eligible rich-result type.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add, fix, or review structured data for articles, products, FAQs, etc., or when markup doesn't earn a rich result.

say_en.text: Add JSON-LD structured data to this product page.
say_en.note: Generates a block with required properties like name, offers.

say_en.text: Check which required properties this article's schema is missing.
say_en.note: Runs the validator and points out missing or invalid fields.

say_en.text: Why doesn't my markup earn a rich result?
